id.description: The file's id: pass it to `POST /files/{file_id}/download-link/`. Every daily file gets a new id; old ids still download.

dataset.description: Which dataset this file is a snapshot of: `us_10m` is the 10M US dataset (10M+ US B2B leads), `us_50m` the 50M US dataset (50M+ US B2B), `coop_up2data` and `coop_harvestapi` the co-op files: every LinkedIn profile fetched through Up2Data, and through HarvestAPI, one flat Parquet table each (columns: docs Dataset fields), rebuilt every day. `GET /files/` lists the newest file of each dataset. `free_list` is a free list we give away (a CSV in a zip): `GET /files/` lists each one you opened the link of (`datacircle.dev/lists/<list>`), and `filename` says which.

filename.description: The name the file downloads as: `us_smb_mid_market.zip`, `coop_up2data.parquet`, `2026-10-07-us-software-founders.zip`.

row_count.description: Rows in the file; `null` when we have not counted it.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, in hex, to check your download; `null` when we have not measured it.

is_unlocked.description: Whether this workspace may download it: always `true` for `us_10m` and `free_list`; `true` for `coop_up2data` and `coop_harvestapi` once this workspace has added $50 in funds or 3 people you invited signed up; `true` for `us_50m` only once 3 people you invited signed up (`GET /me/invites/`).
